create_verifier: create a Verifier instance with lookahead, device, and target ModelRunner for speculative decoding verification
run_prefill: run prefill on a list of Sequences to initialize recovery tokens and optionally capture Eagle hidden states
run_verify: run verification of speculative tokens against the target model to produce accepted suffixes and recovery tokens
test_verify_eagle: test the verify method with eagle mode enabled to include hidden state tracking for speculative decoding
review_verify_metrics: review the verify method to understand how it tracks target verify times, cache hits, and accepted suffix lengths
